newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X CEO says market rumors "nonsense".
newsitem.headline: Bre-X CEO says market rumors "nonsense".

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd chief executive officer David Walsh said on Thursday market rumors that Bre-X may lose another piece of the Busang gold deposit are "nonsense."

Shares in Bre-X, which holds a 45 percent stake under an agreement to develop the gold property with Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc and Indonesian partners, fell 1.20 to close at 17.05 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
Turnover was a hefty 2.79 million shares.
"There are rumors going around that they are going to lose another chunk of the property," said one portfolio manager who declined to be named.
An analyst said he had heard a rumor that Bre-X could lose another five to 10 percent of the property.
Walsh said: "First of all, this rumor is nonsense and I think rumors, unfortunately, will persist until the actual signing of the contracts of work."

"We have a binding agreement that we announced with our Indonesian partners and Freeport McMoRan. It set the percentage terms of ownership of the new operating company for the Busang two deposit," Walsh said.
